data.desc: FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) is a media technology company providing streaming and media monetization solutions through its software-based Platform-as-a-Service ('PaaS') model. FreeCast's white-label platform is designed to enable telecommunications companies, broadband and wireless providers, satellite operators, utilities, residential communities, hospitality groups, membership organizations and other enterprises to offer branded media services to their customers. The Company's technology integrates content discovery, streaming entertainment, subscription management, advertising, transactions and commerce capabilities, with the objective of connecting content providers and enterprise distribution partners through a scalable media and monetization platform.
